versions.short: The bill would amend the Long-Term Leasing Act so that land within the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation and land held in trust for the Wampanoag Tribe of Gay Head (Aquinnah) can be included among the lands eligible for leases of up to 99 years. The bill would add these two areas to the list of tribal lands already covered by that law's leasing authority.
